decision_precedence.condition: unresolved_sev1 == 0 and unresolved_sev2 == 0 and substantive_evidence_sufficient == true

amendment_rationale: First release. RBM-001 governs research conclusions, where the binding constraint is an archive somebody else curates. Engineering review has no such constraint: a test passes or fails, a commit hash is a fact, a build reproduces. RBM-002 exists because that better evidence permits sharper gates, and because the six defect classes it audits were each observed in this system's own code rather than drawn from a checklist.

engineering_gates.name: Gate computation
engineering_gates.requirement: No gate, check, or status may return a pinned constant. Every reported status must be computed from inputs that can change it.
engineering_gates.observed_instance: Four proof gates reported FAIL as a hardcoded literal, so they could never have reported anything else.

engineering_gates.name: Measurement completeness
engineering_gates.requirement: No summary, rate, or aggregate may be written over a denominator that was not enumerated, or a numerator with unattempted members.
engineering_gates.observed_instance: A coverage census wrote a summary after retrieving zero records; a later run recorded rate limits as absences.

engineering_gates.name: Enforcement fidelity
engineering_gates.requirement: Every stated requirement must name the constant, test, or code path that enforces it. A requirement that exists only as prose is not a requirement.
engineering_gates.observed_instance: A three-district corroboration threshold was documented and enforced nowhere.

engineering_gates.name: Attestation integrity
engineering_gates.requirement: No attestation may be recorded by the process that produced the value it attests to, and no actor may sign as another.
engineering_gates.observed_instance: A demonstration run recorded a human transcriber's name against a figure the process itself had read.

engineering_gates.name: Sentinel handling
engineering_gates.requirement: Values meaning unknown, unset, or not yet determined must never be equality-matched, compared, or counted as results.
engineering_gates.observed_instance: Two records both classified to an unclassified fallback matched each other, producing a false corroboration PASS.

engineering_gates.name: Reproducibility
engineering_gates.requirement: The reviewed commit hash and the observed test result must be recorded, and the result must reproduce from a clean checkout.
engineering_gates.observed_instance: Test counts were quoted from memory across sessions rather than from a recorded run.
